permitDetails.description: Permit-level metadata copied exactly from the permit; do not infer or normalize beyond date formatting when unambiguous.

permitNumber.description: The actual permit number/identifier only (e.g., '11790', '21050040', '08010054'). Extract only the numeric or alphanumeric identifier, excluding labels like 'Registration No.:', 'Application No.:', 'Permit', etc. For permits with multiple identifiers (e.g., 'Application No.: 21050040 I.D. No.: 031471AEN'), extract the primary permit number (21050040) and document all identifiers found in extractionNotes. Do not include permit type descriptions or renewal status.

permitIssuanceDate.description: Date the permit was issued. Use YYYY-MM-DD if unambiguous; else null.

permitExpirationDate.description: Expiration date if explicitly stated; null if not listed.

facilityName.description: Facility name exactly as written in the permit; do not normalize.

facilityAddress.description: Full facility street address exactly as written; do not normalize.

facilityCounty.description: County exactly as written in the permit for the facility location.

facilityState.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for the facility location.

extractionNotes.description: Optional field for documenting permit-level extraction decisions. Use ONLY when: (1) multiple permit identifiers exist and you selected the primary one (e.g., 'Selected Application No. 21050040 as primary identifier; also found ID No. 031471AEN'); (2) ambiguity in facility name or address required clarification; (3) date format was ambiguous and you made an interpretation. Leave null if extraction was straightforward.

generatorSets.description: Array of generator set objects, each containing details about a single generator set as described in the document. Do not consolidate generator sets even if they share make and model types, and list them in order which they appear in the document.

items.description: One entry per referenced unit or unit group as listed in the permit (e.g., EG01, EG04–EG05, 1510-4). Do not synthesize extra rows.

referenceNumber.description: Unit or group identifier used by the permit (e.g., EG01, EG04–EG05, 1510-4).

numGenerators.description: Count of engines in this reference. Use only a number explicitly tied to this reference; else null.

make.description: If multiple makes/models are listed for the same reference (e.g., 'Caterpillar 3516C or MTU 16V4000 DS2250 or equivalent'), select one deterministically: (1) prefer the option with the smallest stated electrical rating (kW); (2) if kW is not given for all, compare BHP and pick the smallest; (3) if still tied, pick the first explicitly named make. Copy the chosen make verbatim as a single value. Do not include 'or', 'equivalent', or list multiple options. Document alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

model.description: Apply the same selection rule as 'make'. Copy the chosen model verbatim that corresponds to the selected make as a single value. Do not include 'or' or list multiple models. Document alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

ratedCapacityBHP.description: Numeric BHP nameplate for the selected make/model only. If multiple BHP values are shown, record the smallest stated BHP as a single number. Do not convert from kW. Do not include 'or' or text. Document higher alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

ratedCapacityKW.description: Numeric kW nameplate for the selected make/model only. If multiple kW values are shown (e.g., '2,500 kW each or 2,250 kW each'), record the smallest stated kW as a single number. Do not convert from BHP. Do not include 'or' or text. Document higher alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

maximumCapacityBHP.description: Numeric only as written; null if not stated.

maximumCapacityKW.description: Numeric only as written; null if not stated.

primaryFuelType.description: Verbatim fuel name exactly as written (e.g., 'diesel', 'diesel fuel oil No. 2', 'distillate fuel (Grades No. 1 and 2)', 'ULSD', 'natural gas', 'propane', 'biodiesel', 'B20', 'dual fuel'). Do not normalize or infer grade; leave null if not stated. For complex descriptions with multiple grades or options, record verbatim and optionally clarify interpretation in extractionNotes.

secondaryFuelType.description: Secondary type of fuel for dual-fuel or multi-fuel generators (e.g., 'natural gas' for a generator that can switch between diesel and natural gas). Leave null if not applicable.

otherFuels.description: Additional fuels beyond primary and secondary for generators with 3+ fuel options. Describe as free text (e.g., 'renewable diesel, biodiesel blends'). Leave null if not applicable.

fuelThroughputLimit.description: Maximum fuel consumption for this reference as a number only. Do not guess units or basis here.

fuelSulfurContent.description: Enter the PERCENT value only when a percent is explicitly stated (e.g., 0.5 for 0.5%). Do not convert ppm to percent; leave null if not stated.

controlTechnology.description: Emission control technology or pollution control devices used on the generator. Extract from 'Emission Controls' or 'Process Requirements' sections. Common examples: 'turbocharged engine and aftercooler', 'selective catalytic reduction (SCR)', 'diesel oxidation catalyst (DOC)', 'good operating practices and maintenance per manufacturer recommendations'. Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursLimit.description: Maximum allowed hours per year for this reference as a number only. If the permit uses a rolling 12-month basis, store the number only; do not include basis text here.

noxEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

noxEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

coEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

coEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

vocEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

vocEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

pmEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

pmEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

pm10EmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

pm10EmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

so2EmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

so2EmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Numeric as written for this reference. Do not aggregate or apportion. Use 'emissionsScope'/'emissionsGroupRef' to indicate scope.

stackTestRequired.description: Indicates if a stack test is required for this generator set. Leave null if not specified in permit.

fuelGrade.description: If the permit explicitly names a grade, copy verbatim (e.g., 'No. 2', 'No. 1'). Do not infer.

fuelSpecification.description: Standards/specifications verbatim when cited (e.g., 'ASTM D975', 'ASTM D396-78', '40 CFR 80.510').

fuelSulfurContentPpm.description: Enter sulfur in ppm only when ppm is explicitly stated (e.g., 15). Do not convert percent to ppm.

ulsd.description: True only if ULSD or ≤15 ppm sulfur is explicitly required; false only if >15 ppm is explicitly allowed; null otherwise.

fuelNormalized.description: Optional normalization bucket; populate only when unambiguous from source text. Allowed values: distillate_no2, distillate_no1, natural_gas, propane, biodiesel_blend, dual_fuel, other. Otherwise null. If normalization required interpretation or mapping of ambiguous fuel descriptions, document the source text and reasoning in extractionNotes (e.g., 'Mapped diesel fuel oil No. 2 → distillate_no2').

includedInPermitProject.description: True if explicitly listed as included in this permitting action; false if listed only as previously/other permitted equipment; null if not distinguished.

emissionsScope.description: Scope for emission limits: 'per_unit' when limits apply to each unit; 'combined_group' for a stated unit range; 'facility_wide' for totals; null if not stated. If ambiguous or requires interpretation of table structure/context, document reasoning in extractionNotes.

emissionsGroupRef.description: Exact label/range when combined or facility-wide (e.g., 'EG04–EG05 combined', 'facility-wide'). If interpretation was required to determine grouping, document in extractionNotes.

fuelThroughputScope.description: Scope for throughput: 'per_unit', 'combined_group', or 'facility_wide'; null if not stated.

fuelThroughputGroupRef.description: Exact label/range when combined throughput applies (e.g., 'EG01–EG07').

allowedOperatingModes.description: Only include modes explicitly authorized. Map: 'emergency only'→'emergency'; ISO/RTO emergencies→'ISO_emergency'; 'maintenance/testing'→'maintenance_testing'; agency-approved non-emergency→'non_emergency_after_approval'. If the permit references 40 CFR 60.4211(f) hour carve-outs or similar state limits, map modes accordingly; do not invent hours. For non-obvious CFR mappings, document the regulation reference and interpretation in extractionNotes (e.g., 'Mapped 40 CFR 60.4211(f)(2) maintenance allowance → maintenance_testing').

opacityLimitPercent.description: Percent opacity per EPA Method 9 when explicitly stated; otherwise null.

hourMeter.description: True if a non-resettable hour meter is required or present.

fuelFlowMeter.description: True only if a fuel flow meter is explicitly required.

observationFrequency.description: Minimum observation cadence as written (e.g., 'monthly if operated').

recordkeepingWindowYears.description: Years to retain records if explicitly stated (e.g., 5).

monitoring.description: Monitoring and recordkeeping explicitly tied to this reference. Do not infer.

nspsSubpartIIII.description: True if the permit explicitly states applicability; false if explicitly not applicable; null if not mentioned.

mactSubpartZZZZ.description: True if the permit explicitly states applicability; false if explicitly not applicable; null if not mentioned.

extractionNotes.description: Optional field for documenting extraction decisions when alternatives or ambiguities exist in source document. Use ONLY when: (1) multiple make/model options were listed and you selected one per the deterministic rule (e.g., 'Selected Caterpillar 3516C (2500 kW) from alternatives: Caterpillar 3516C or MTU 16V4000 DS2250'); (2) multiple capacity values were listed and you selected the smallest (e.g., 'Selected 2250 kW from: 2500 kW or 2250 kW'); (3) other extraction ambiguities requiring clarification. Leave null if extraction was straightforward with no alternatives.
